title: Illustration Library Cont.
slide_intent: Build stories from a consistent illustration vocabulary so people recognize both the food and the playful human experience around it.
strategic_value: The repeated ingredient colors and expressive faces can make Burger King food feel familiar and personable across communications.
demonstration: A green field pairs a library note with labeled products and storytelling illustrations, including fries, cups, pickle eye masks, fry mustaches and hands holding food.
practical_value: Choose an existing product or storytelling asset while retaining its supplied colors.

content_islands.name: Library note
content_islands.spec: Place the Cachetejack partnership note and prohibition on color changes at left.

content_islands.name: Products
content_islands.spec: Arrange fries, bursting ketchup sachets and soda cups across the upper right.

content_islands.name: Storytelling
content_islands.spec: Group faces, hands, food gestures and flames beneath the products, retaining descriptive captions.

reference_purposes.Expression: The specimens use irregular flat shapes and playful faces and gestures in the food palette.
reference_purposes.Application: The labeled library supplies product and storytelling assets for selection.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The note says no colors should be amended.
